desc: Enterprise AI security and governance platform. Read on 1 September 2026, the vendor leads with finding AI rather than building it: Airia says it discovers every AI tool, model, agent and MCP server running across an organisation, including the ones nobody approved, enforces policy at the execution layer before a tool call fires or an email sends, and generates continuous governance documentation mapped to the EU AI Act, NIST AI RMF, SR 11-7, HIPAA, ISO 42001 and SOC 2. The no-code/low-code/pro-code agent builder, connectors and MCP support are still there, but now sit under Optimize alongside model routing and cost controls. Its July 2026 update, as the vendor describes it, added Model Change Management, which warns up to 90 days before a model deprecation so agents do not break silently; Advanced Context Engineering, aimed at running governed AI over complex, permission-sensitive enterprise data; and cost controls that watch budgets in real time, attribute spend per provider, model, agent and team, and flag runaway agent loops. Read again on 22 September 2026, the security pillar now also lists Agent Red Teaming: the vendor says it simulates multi-step attacks across prompts, tools, APIs and memory layers (prompt injection, tool manipulation and chained attack scenarios) using framework-aligned attack libraries, and maps what it finds back to recognised security frameworks so the findings return as guardrail, constraint and policy changes before agents reach production. We have not tested it.

name: Amplemarket
desc: An AI sales platform: an AI 'Searcher' that turns a plain-English ICP into verified contacts, 100+ contact-level buying-intent signals, and social prospecting from LinkedIn, plus multichannel outreach and deliverability tooling, drawing on a large multi-source contact database it refreshes continuously. Its Duo copilot proactively surfaces prioritized leads from 20+ real-time signal types, and an MCP server puts the platform inside ChatGPT or Claude, where it can triage the Unibox, update or remove leads, and since July run a whole account-based play end to end: research the account, pull enriched profiles, and enrol every contact into one sequence with copy written per person and per step, without leaving the chat. A GTM Skills Library opens the rest of the platform along the same route. Duo Voice is the audio arm of the same copilot: you read one short sample aloud, it clones your voice, and a voice-message step can then be dropped into any sequence, with the message written per prospect from their data and adapted to their language. These are LinkedIn voice notes rather than another block of text. Since June you can also describe a workflow in plain English and have it built for you in the normal editor, and meeting notes from Fathom and Attention flow into the activity feed. Deliverability is a named toolkit rather than a footnote: a Domain Health Center for SPF/DKIM/DMARC, inbox-to-outbox ratio, spam-list and mailbox-age monitoring; automated warm-up and recovery for flagged Gmail or Outlook mailboxes; weekly spam-placement tests before a campaign goes out; and Duo rotating the sending mailbox per email against that same health data. Workflows, the automation layer, is included for every customer rather than sold as a premium add-on: triggers (a sequence finishing with no reply, a bounce, a meeting booked, a call logged, a CRM field changing), filters for who qualifies, branching paths and actions (enrol in another sequence, update CRM fields, create tasks, manage lists, enrich, add to exclusion lists), assembled on a visual canvas so the whole logic is readable at a glance. Twenty ready-made Recipes cover lead routing, keeping non-responders warm, account plays, CRM hygiene and do-not-contact enforcement. It runs against Salesforce and HubSpot out of the box, and without a CRM connected the triggers and actions that don't depend on one still work. The browser extension carries the same work into whatever page you are on: adding and editing notes, creating and running tasks, and filtering the activity feed without switching tabs.

desc: Private, ad-free email hosting with your own domain. Fast, secure email, calendars and contacts from an independent provider that doesn't mine your data. desc: AI-driven Amazon and retail-media optimization: dynamic repricing, ad automation and analytics for brands and larger sellers on Amazon and Walmart.

Case management for law firms: matters, intake, depositions, e-signature and AI document work.

Finale Inventory

name: FlexiQuiz
desc: Online quiz and test maker for educators, trainers and businesses: build graded exams, assessments and simple courses with certificates, timed tests, question banks and analytics. There is a free tier.

desc: PDF editing, OCR and organising priced under Acrobat, per user per year for the desktop editor or Editor+, which now bundles Foxit eSign. A perpetual licence is also sold, and the AI Assistant is a separate add-on.

desc: AI-powered SEO content writing and optimization: research, outline, write and optimize articles that rank, all in one place.
Invoicing and accounting aimed at freelancers and service businesses, priced by billable clients.

Freshchat

FullEnrich
desc: B2B contact enrichment with waterfall data. Find verified emails and direct phone numbers for prospects by combining 20+ data providers in one lookup.

desc: Turns a prompt or rough notes into a deck, document or webpage draft. Output still needs a human pass for high-stakes decks.

desc: Shows per-location stock on the product page plus a store-locator map, so shoppers can see which branch has the item. It displays inventory rather than managing it.

desc: Seven separate AI workspaces (decks, articles, visuals, briefs, proposals, legal drafts and books), each sold on its own plan.

desc: No-code app builder, now sold as Glide Classic next to the newer GlideOS, that turns spreadsheets and databases into working business apps: internal tools, client portals and field apps, with workflows and an API.

Helpdesk built for ecommerce: tickets, automations and an AI agent, priced by volume rather than by seat -- though the entry tier caps you at three users.
name: Gorgias
GrapeLeads
desc: Lead-finding for web developers and agencies: surfaces local businesses without websites from Google Maps, with contact details, on signup credits.

name: Grapevine
desc: Shopify-native survey platform for post-purchase, NPS, CSAT and attribution questions, with unlimited responses on a single plan. Launched August 2017.

desc: Self-hosted WordPress form builder with conditional logic, payments and deep integrations.

desc: Property management for short-term and vacation rentals: bookings, guest messaging, channel distribution and pricing in one dashboard. Heavy for a single listing.

name: Gusto
desc: Payroll, benefits and HR on one platform. Automated tax filings, employee onboarding and time tracking, so you can run payroll for your whole team in just a few clicks.

desc: Practice management and EHR for health, wellness and nutrition providers: scheduling, telehealth, secure messaging, billing and a branded client portal, plus a full API (GraphQL + webhooks) for automation. Built to scale with group practices.

desc: Done-for-you bookkeeping and taxes built for therapists and a growing range of health-and-wellness practices (SLPs, dieticians, chiropractors, audiologists, coaches, massage and physical therapists): monthly books, quarterly tax estimates, annual filing and S-corp support by specialists who know the niche.

name: Hello Bar
desc: Sticky bars, popups, slide-ins and full-screen takeovers for lead capture, with A/B testing and targeting rules. The meter is popup views rather than signups, so a traffic spike raises the bill however few emails you captured.

name: HelpCenter
desc: Shopify helpdesk with live chat and an AI FAQ builder: email, chat and Messenger in one ticket queue, plus SEO-friendly FAQ pages.

name: HiBob
desc: HRIS with onboarding, time-off and people analytics, built for scaling mid-size companies. Quote-only, per employee per month: third-party estimates cluster in the mid-teens, plus a one-off implementation fee reported at roughly 10–20% of the annual value. Get the number in writing.

name: Hive
desc: Project management and team collaboration in one workspace. Plan projects, assign tasks and centralize communication so work keeps moving.

name: Hopp
desc: Business travel management from Bolt, branded Hopp: book and control company rides from one dashboard, with per-person and per-group spend limits, automated ride reports, expensing integrations and a single consolidated monthly invoice. No activation cost and no minimum commitment; you pay per ride.

name: Hostinger
desc: Affordable, fast hosting with an AI website builder built in. Free domain, free SSL and 24/7 support, suited to founders launching their first MVP or side project.

name: Housecall Pro
desc: Field service management for home-service businesses. Schedule jobs, dispatch techs, send quotes and invoices, and take payments from one app.

name: HubSpot
desc: CRM platform with marketing, sales, service and content hubs on one contact database.
Time tracking with screenshots, activity levels, GPS and payroll integration for distributed teams.

Iconosquare

name: IDrive
desc: Cloud backup across many devices, with versioning, snapshots and physical seed-and-restore shipping.

desc: Shopify app that drops your own logo, or snow, hearts and dozens of holiday presets, down the storefront, with a marquee slider for partner, payment and press logos and an AI logo maker for the artwork.

name: InboxAlly
desc: Email deliverability tool that trains your sender reputation: engagement-based signals keep your campaigns and cold outreach out of spam and in the primary inbox. Works alongside any ESP or email platform.

name: Increff
desc: Warehouse management plus algorithm-driven merchandising and inventory optimisation for omnichannel retail. There is no public pricing and no flat fee; every deal is quoted case by case against warehouses, users and modules, so budget for an enterprise implementation.

name: Insightful
desc: A work intelligence platform: workforce analytics plus AI process capture, covering time tracking, how work actually flows, and insider-threat detection as a paid add-on, priced per seat.

desc: Enterprise landing-page and conversion platform: build, personalize and A/B-test post-click landing pages at scale, with ad-to-page mapping, heatmaps and fast AMP pages. Built for paid-ads and demand-gen teams.

desc: Monitors competitor prices on Google Shopping and direct competitor sites and reprices your Shopify catalogue automatically with AI matching rules.

desc: Turns a prompt or script into a first-draft video with AI voiceover, templates and stock footage. Plans are priced per seat and metered in monthly credits that do not roll over.

name: involve.me
desc: Interactive funnel builder: quizzes, calculators, assessments and payment pages with built-in email sequences, a CRM for the leads they capture, A/B testing between two versions, and an AI funnel builder metered in AI credits. Free tier to start; paid tiers are priced by the number of live funnels.
Time and attendance tracking with facial recognition, GPS and payroll-ready timesheets.
name: Jibble
Joiin

name: Pippit
desc: AI marketing-content maker by CapCut: turns a product link into marketing videos, avatar presenters, talking photos and sales posters, with scheduling and multi-platform publishing. Credit-based, with a free tier that needs no card. Seedance 2.5 is now listed among its video models: clips up to 30 seconds, text timestamps to pin key moments, footage extension for longer scenes and reference inputs to steer the direction, although their own model page still describes it with "upcoming" wording (checked 4 Aug 2026). A separate Story Studio section has since appeared in their own navigation, grouping AI Drama, AI film, AI Movie, AI Script and AI Workflow (checked 3 Sep 2026).

name: Pixel Union
desc: Premium Shopify themes bought once rather than by subscription, from Pixel Union and its sister brand Out of the Sandbox. A theme is a starting point; the conversion lift comes from how you configure and populate it, not from the purchase.

name: Planday
desc: Employee scheduling and time tracking for shift businesses, owned by Xero. 30-day trial, no card.

name: Plansom
desc: AI-assisted planning for tasks, goals and team collaboration. A smaller player next to Asana and ClickUp, with fewer integrations and less third-party support around it. No public price: plans show only after signing in.

name: Plesk
desc: Server control panel for agencies and hosters running many sites: per-domain management, security and one-click stacks. Domain caps drive the tier, and a roughly 26% average price rise took effect in January 2026.

name: Post Purchase Upsell Hero
desc: One-click post-purchase upsell and downsell offers for Shopify, with targeting rules, AI product recommendations, A/B testing and a revenue dashboard.
SMS marketing for Shopify stores: campaigns, automations and opt-in tools.
name: Postscript
Prezi
desc: AI presentation maker for dynamic, non-linear decks that differ from standard slides: turn ideas into interactive presentations fast.

name: Pricefy
desc: Competitor price monitoring and dynamic repricing for e-commerce, with AI product matching, price-intelligence dashboards, feed channels and autopilot repricing.

name: Printify
desc: Global print-on-demand network. Create custom products and automate your e-commerce fulfillment without holding inventory.

name: Process Street
desc: Recurring work as trackable checklists and SOPs, with approvals and conditional logic.

name: ProtectMyOrder
desc: Shopify checkout upsell for premium services: package protection against lost and stolen parcels, carbon-neutral shipping and free returns, sold on the cart page, in checkout or through a custom widget, with fixed, dynamic or percentage pricing and an A/B test against half your traffic. On the vendor's own pricing page a 44.99% tier puts their agents on those claims, and a further 30% hands them the liability for refunds and replacements.

name: Proton
desc: Privacy-first suite from the makers of ProtonMail: encrypted mail, calendar, drive, VPN and password manager under one account, with a free tier and paid bundles.

name: Proton Drive
desc: End-to-end encrypted cloud storage from a Swiss provider. Because Proton cannot read your files there is no server-side search inside documents, integrations are thinner, and losing your credentials without recovery loses the data.

name: Pumper Bundles
desc: Shopify bundle app by Profit Pumper: unlimited product bundles, quantity breaks, volume and cart discounts, BOGO and free-gift offers, with cart drawer and page builder integrations. The plans are a revenue ceiling rather than a feature ladder: all four carry identical features.

name: PushOwl
desc: Shopify web-push and omnichannel marketing, now part of Brevo. One-click push lets stores re-engage shoppers who never leave an email, recovering abandoned carts and browsing sessions, then add email, SMS and WhatsApp on Brevo's deliverability stack. Usage-based pricing: you pay for what you send, not list size.

name: Pylon
desc: B2B customer support platform built for Slack and Microsoft Teams. Manage tickets, track issues, and deliver white-glove support directly where your clients chat.

name: Pythago
desc: AI analytics and ROI tracking for dropshippers: real-time ROAS optimization, product research and competitor tools across one or more Shopify stores.

name: Qoyod
desc: Saudi accounting and e-invoicing platform built around ZATCA compliance, used by 25,000+ businesses.

name: Quartile
desc: Retail media optimisation across Amazon Sponsored Ads and Amazon DSP, Walmart, Instacart, Criteo, Google, Meta and Microsoft, and ChatGPT Ads as well since August 2026 (the vendor told us on 31 Aug 2026; we have not seen it ourselves), sold as a platform plus a dedicated account team rather than a self-serve tool. Demo-led with no public pricing of any kind: no tiers, no entry rate, nothing on the pricing page. The 41% average ROAS uplift on their homepage is the vendor's own claim.

name: QuickBooks UK
desc: Intuit's accounting platform for the UK market: bookkeeping, VAT and Making Tax Digital submissions, invoicing and payroll as a paid add-on.

name: QuickSigner
desc: Legally binding e-signatures with unlimited documents and no per-envelope caps: send a secure link and recipients sign from any device without creating an account. ISO/IEC 27001-certified, AATL signatures, valid across the US, UK and EU; a fair-priced DocuSign alternative.

name: QuillBot
desc: Paraphrasing, grammar, summarising and plagiarism checking in one box of writing utilities.

name: Quo
desc: Shared business numbers, texting and AI call summaries for small teams, formerly OpenPhone. Call reliability off Wi-Fi is the recurring complaint, and there is no video conferencing.

name: Rank Math
desc: WordPress SEO plugin with schema, on-page analysis and rank tracking.

name: ReachStream
desc: B2B contact database with a published price instead of a quote: unlimited contact and company views on every tier, with the meter running on exports rather than on looking. Annual billing takes 20% off the price and changes nothing about the allowance. Read on their own pricing page, re-read 12 November 2026.

name: Readymode
desc: Predictive dialler with compliance tooling and supervisor monitoring for high-volume outbound floors. Premium per seat, and predictive dialling carries real TCPA compliance responsibility.

name: Reclaim.ai
desc: Auto-schedules tasks, habits and meetings around your stated priorities. Google Calendar-first, so Outlook-heavy teams are out, and the free tier is limited.

name: Reditus
desc: Affiliate-program software plus marketplace for B2B SaaS: launch, manage and scale a partner program with tracking, automated payouts and affiliate discovery.

name: Remote People
desc: Employer of Record and global hiring in 150+ countries. Recruitment is charged separately at 20-25% of annual salary.

name: Replit
desc: Browser-based coding environment with instant deploys and an AI agent. Billing is effort-based: each plan includes monthly credits that the Agent draws down at a rate you do not set, the credits are monthly (on Pro, unused credits roll over for two months), and a complex agent session burns them fast, which makes production costs hard to budget.

name: Reply.io
desc: AI-driven sales engagement platform. Automate your cold outreach across email, LinkedIn, and calls while keeping the human touch. Now includes a mobile app (Jason AI) for iOS and Android to run outreach on the go.

name: respond.io
desc: Shared inbox for WhatsApp, Instagram, Messenger, SMS, email and live chat, with workflow automation, broadcasts and AI agents on top. The catch is where the line sits: automation, broadcasts, AI agents and the API all start at Growth, so the entry plan is the inbox without the engine.

name: Restream
desc: Multistreaming studio: broadcast one show to YouTube, LinkedIn, Facebook and Twitch at once from the browser, with guests and local recordings.

name: Retouch4me
desc: AI retouching plugins for photographers (Photoshop-compatible, Mac/Windows), sold as perpetual licences per plugin, as full-suite subscriptions with retouch credits, or as cloud retouching in credit packs. Free to try first: two free plugins, three free apps and a demo on every paid plugin.

name: Rippling
desc: Workforce platform that unifies HR, IT and Finance in one system of record: run payroll and benefits, manage hiring, onboarding and time tracking, and provision devices and app access automatically, with policy-driven automation across employee data, approvals and compliance. Three additions the vendor announced during 2026, read on rippling.com on 22 September 2026 and not something we have tested: Helpdesk (announced 1 September), an agent that resolves routine IT requests (app access, password resets, device replacements) through deterministic, admin-approved steps across Rippling's own device, inventory and identity tools; AI Governance (announced 20 August), which breaks AI spend down by employee attribute and governs how staff connect LLMs to other tools; and Data Cloud, an AI-powered BI layer over the same employee record. Check availability before you buy the middle one: on Rippling's own AI Governance page only the AI Spend Console invites you to try it, while the AI Gateway and the discovery of unsanctioned AI use are waitlists and the MCP Gateway routes to sales.

name: Riverside
desc: Records podcasts and video locally at each end, so guests on poor connections still come out broadcast-quality.

name: RocketReach
desc: Contact data and prospecting: look up verified work and personal email addresses plus direct and mobile phone numbers, filter on 50+ criteria, then push the result into Salesforce, HubSpot, Outreach, Salesloft or Bullhorn. Sequences, an AI email writer and Autopilot jobs that keep a saved search running come with the paid plans, with technographics, org charts and intent topics higher up. The database size (700 million professionals, 60 million companies) and the 98% accuracy figure are RocketReach's own.

name: Ruby
desc: Live human receptionists answering your calls, plus chat. Premium rates that pay off only when a missed call is a lost client.

name: Runpod
desc: Serverless GPU compute platform. Rent high-end NVIDIA GPUs by the hour to train and deploy your own machine learning models.

name: Salesflare
desc: CRM for small B2B teams that auto-logs emails, meetings and contact details from your inbox and calendar. Deliberately lean: no built-in dialer, no quoting or invoicing, and basic reporting unless you export.

name: Salesflow
desc: LinkedIn outreach automation for outbound sales teams: connection requests, follow-up sequences and Open InMails, with email steps for multichannel campaigns, plus an admin panel and seat management for agencies.

name: Salesmessage
desc: Business texting and SMS marketing in one shared inbox. Reach customers where they actually reply with two-way texting, automation and team collaboration.

name: SaneBox
desc: Email triage that moves low-priority mail out of the inbox and works with any provider. The honest catch: you are paying monthly to filter mail that modern email clients increasingly sort for free.

name: Scarcity.AI
desc: Three Shopify urgency apps (low stock counter, countdown timer and live visitors counter) that read real data but let you choose which true number the shopper sees.

name: Scrolly
desc: Free Shopify app from Effectify that adds a customizable floating back-to-top button and, optionally, infinite scroll on collection pages, with no code and no paid tier. The button is a safe convenience; the infinite scroll replaces the paginated collection URLs crawlers use, so it is a merchandising decision rather than a styling one.

name: Seamless.ai
desc: B2B contact database with AI list-building, plus an MCP server so Claude or ChatGPT can run the searching and enrichment. Nothing above the free plan (1 user, 50 credits) carries a published price; the only quantity their FAQ names is a Pro floor of 10,000 annual credits. Independent tests put deliverability near 74%, and contracts auto-renew with 30-60 days' notice to cancel.

name: Section Library
desc: Shopify app that adds 200+ ready-made theme sections plus AI-generated custom ones (Gemini 3.1 Pro), all inside the native theme editor so layouts change without a developer. Live since October 2023 with a single App Store review.

name: Securify
desc: Country blocker and fraud filter for Shopify: blocks countries, IP ranges, bots, VPNs and risky emails at checkout, and holds suspicious orders automatically.

name: Seel
desc: Shopper-paid returns and shipping protection for Shopify, BigCommerce and Adobe Commerce. Customers add Worry-Free Purchase at checkout and Seel pays the refund instead of you, free for the merchant.

name: Selixer
desc: Shopify profit dashboard that nets ad spend, COGS, returns and fees out of revenue and reports what you keep per product, campaign and customer, built for fashion and apparel brands.

name: Seller Investigators
desc: Amazon FBA reimbursement recovery on contingency: a free 48-hour audit, then a 25% commission charged only after Amazon deposits recovered funds. No subscription. Ask which cases Amazon would have settled automatically before you sign.

name: Seller Snap
desc: AI repricer and seller-analytics platform for Amazon and Walmart: what the vendor calls game-theory repricing, aimed at Buy Box share rather than racing to the bottom, plus min/max profit calculation, 80+ analytics data points and imports from tools like InventoryLab and SkuVault. 15-day free trial, no credit card. A July 2026 interface release adds live Buy Box insight with SKU-level filters, multi-store management from one screen including bulk cost updates, repricing from mobile, historical inventory-value tracking, saved views, customizable columns and a dark mode.

name: Sellfy
desc: No-code store builder for creators to sell digital products, subscriptions and print-on-demand merch, with zero transaction fees and built-in social-media selling.

name: Sendcloud
desc: European e-commerce shipping platform: connect 160+ carriers, print labels in batches, show delivery options at checkout, send branded tracking (email, WhatsApp, SMS) and run a self-service returns portal, with rules-based shipping automation. Available to online retailers in 8 countries (Netherlands, Belgium, UK, France, Germany, Austria, Italy, Spain). Free plan available.

name: Sentaro
desc: Email threat detection that flags phishing, risky and malicious messages right in your inbox. It surfaces the dangerous emails that look perfectly normal, before anyone clicks.

name: SEO Space
desc: SEO tool built exclusively for Squarespace, delivered as a Chrome extension paired with a web dashboard. The extension runs inside the Squarespace editor and on live pages, scoring each page and saying in plain language what to change and where the setting lives; the dashboard adds site-wide audits, keyword rank tracking, backlink and competitor data, local SEO tools and scheduled white-label PDF client reports. Pricing is keyed to the number of websites rather than seats, which is why it suits freelancers and studios managing client sites.

name: SEOmatic
desc: SEO suite for Shopify from Aheadworks: unlimited image compression with alt text, AI-generated meta titles and descriptions, SEO audit, schema markup and both XML and HTML sitemaps. Live since 2015.

name: Serpstat
desc: SEO platform covering keyword research, competitor analysis, rank tracking, site audit and backlink data, cheaper on annual billing, with a 7-day trial that takes a card and auto-renews.
Job management for trades and service contractors: scheduling, quotes, job cards and invoicing.
name: ServiceM8
Shiftie
desc: Rota building, clock-ins, leave and shift swaps for shift-based businesses. Not an HR or payroll platform, so those stay separate purchases.

name: Shipdock
desc: Shopify pickup points, multi-carrier label printing and cash-on-delivery tracking, strongest on the Central European carrier networks. Listed in the Shopify App Store as "ShipD Labels & Pickup points" (apps.shopify.com/packeta) - same app by happyapps.cz, Shipdock is the earlier name (checked 18 September 2026).

name: Shippo
desc: Multi-carrier shipping software for e-commerce. Compare rates, print discounted labels and automate tracking across carriers, with shipping that scales with your store.

name: Shoeboxed
desc: Turns paper and digital receipts into organized, IRS-ready expense data with OCR plus human verification, and syncs with QuickBooks and Xero.

name: Shorby
desc: Link-in-bio pages and short links, with messenger deep-links into WhatsApp or Telegram and retargeting pixels firing on every click.

name: Shore
desc: Booking and business software for local service businesses (salons, barbers, wellness, coaches): 24/7 online appointments via your website, Google and Instagram, calendar and staff scheduling, client profiles, automated reminders that cut no-shows, plus email marketing and POS. Fixed monthly price with unlimited bookings and no per-booking commission.

name: Signable
desc: UK-based electronic signature software for sending, signing and tracking documents, priced by the envelope with unlimited users and templates, UK-hosted data and an API on higher plans.

name: Signal House
desc: SMS and Voice API positioned as a Twilio alternative. A2P 10DLC fees are published; voice rates are not.

name: Signeasy
desc: E-signature and contract management for SMBs: unlimited signing and sending, templates, audit trails and integrations, priced per seat.

name: SignNow
desc: Electronic signatures and custom eSignature workflows by airSlate. Send, sign and manage documents on any device, legally binding and team-friendly.
Competitive intelligence on web traffic, search and ads: what your competitors' visitors do.
name: Similarweb
SimpleTexting
desc: SMS marketing and business texting: run mass-text campaigns, two-way conversations and automations with compliance built in.

name: SimplyBook.me
desc: Online booking and scheduling system for service businesses: booking website and widget, provider calendars, automated reminders and online payments.

name: Smartli
desc: AI writing suite for e-commerce: product listings, ad copy, SEO text and brand assets. Each of the nine tools is competent rather than deep, so leaning hard on one job means outgrowing it.

name: SmartSuite
desc: Flexible work management platform to plan, track and automate any process. Projects, CRM and operations side by side, replacing a stack of scattered tools with a single source of truth.

name: Smarty Discounts
desc: Shopify discount engine for the rules the native one cannot express: capped and fixed-amount discounts that hold up across currencies, tiers by quantity, subtotal or weight, BXGY, gifts and mix-and-match, targeted by product, customer, cart, market, country or company. Each tier includes two discounts at the level above. Launched January 2025, six reviews as of 4 Sep 2026.

name: SMTP.com
desc: Transactional and bulk email delivery via SMTP relay and API: high-deliverability sending for app notifications, receipts and campaigns, with real-time analytics and dedicated IPs. Built for volume senders.

name: SMTP2GO
desc: Reliable transactional and bulk email delivery. Send via a simple SMTP relay or API with strong deliverability, real-time analytics and global sending infrastructure.

name: SocialBee
desc: Social media management and scheduling with content categories. Plan, recycle and publish posts across all your channels from one calendar.

name: Softr
desc: Build custom AI business apps, client portals and internal tools without code. Connect Airtable, Google Sheets or your data and launch in an afternoon.

name: Spiky.ai
desc: AI meeting intelligence for revenue teams: records and analyses sales calls, tracks keywords and talk patterns, and coaches reps.

name: Spocket
desc: Dropshipping platform with vetted US and EU suppliers. Find fast-shipping products, add them to your store in a click and automate order fulfillment.

name: Stackable
desc: Shopify discount app (by Optizio) that folds several discounts into one code: order, collection and shipping discounts combined, a progress type that raises the discount as the cart grows, and checkout upsells on the top tier.

name: Stamped
desc: Reviews, ratings and loyalty platform for e-commerce: collect product reviews and user-generated content, run rewards and loyalty programs, and show social proof to lift conversions on Shopify and other stores.

name: Stampezee
desc: Digital stamp cards for local businesses, replacing paper punch cards. Public pricing stays thin, so re-check the tiers before committing.

name: StoreFAQ
desc: Builds SEO-friendly FAQ pages and product FAQ accordions with JSON-LD schema on Shopify, plus an AI chatbot, instant answers and live chat.

name: StoreSEO
desc: SEO suite for Shopify: bulk meta titles and descriptions, image compression and alt text, JSON-LD schema, sitemap submission, instant indexing requests and Search Console reporting, with AI credits for generated copy.

name: Storista
desc: Shopify app that turns TikTok, Reels and UGC clips into shoppable video widgets (carousels, stories, grids and spotlights), with auto-sync from TikTok and Instagram.
Interactive product demos you can embed, with analytics on who watched what.
name: Storylane
Streak
desc: CRM built directly inside Gmail: manage pipelines, leads and deals from your inbox with email tracking, mail merge and shared views. A fit for teams that live in Google Workspace.

name: Success.co
desc: Strategy execution and OKR platform. Turn goals into action: set objectives, track KPIs and scorecards, run meetings and align teams so strategy actually gets executed rather than just planned.
Daily planning that pulls tasks from your other tools into one deliberate schedule.
name: Sunsama
SupaEasy
desc: No-code Shopify Functions generator (by Nextools): build and migrate custom discount, checkout, payment, shipping and validation logic from the Shopify Admin, with a migrator for deprecated Scripts and an AI generator that writes functions from a plain-language brief.

name: Superfiliate
desc: Creator-led growth for D2C brands: run influencer, affiliate and referral programs in one platform across Shopify, Meta and TikTok Shop, with discovery, automation, gifting and revenue tracking.

name: SupportBee
desc: Email ticketing for collaborative customer service: a shared team inbox where every agent has their own login, plus an integrated knowledge base and, on the upper tier, a customer portal. Per seat, no free plan.

name: Surfer (SurferSEO)
desc: Content optimization against live SERP data, and since 2026 a tracker for how often a brand is cited in AI answers like ChatGPT and Google AI Overviews. Billed yearly at four tiers.

name: SurveyMonkey
desc: Survey and feedback platform: build surveys, collect responses at scale and analyze results for market research, CX and employee feedback. A native Salesforce integration pushes responses straight into Salesforce, triggers workflows off the answers themselves (churn-risk follow-up or an NPS detractor landing on a rep's desk, for instance) and ties feedback back to accounts and pipeline, so sales and CS read it inside the tool they already work in rather than in a separate reporting dashboard.

name: SurveySparrow
desc: Conversational surveys and NPS with a polished respondent experience. Response limits on the lower tiers and a contact-sales wall on API and higher volume make budgeting fiddly, and there is no true monthly billing.

name: Survicate
desc: Customer feedback platform for continuous surveys: NPS, CSAT and in-product micro-surveys across web, in-app, email and link, with templates, audience targeting and native integrations (Segment and RudderStack among them) that pipe feedback straight into your CRM and analytics.

name: Switcher Studio
desc: Multi-camera live production and streaming from iPhones and iPads you already own, with overlays and pay-per-view monetisation.

name: Synthesia
desc: AI avatar video for training, explainers and onboarding: type a script, no camera or actors needed. Re-generating an edit spends the minutes again.

name: Tapform
desc: No-code builder for multi-step lead capture forms, quizzes and popups that you embed on any website, with lead notifications, tracking pixels and CRM integrations; a small free plan and an unlimited plan for agencies and growing sites.

name: Tapita AI SEO Blog Builder
desc: AI blog builder for Shopify: generates SEO-oriented posts with titles, images and keyword suggestions, embeds your products, and schedules bulk publishing from a drag-and-drop editor. The Shopify listing published no plan block and no credit allowance when we re-read it on 19 September 2026; its pricing field reads Free.

name: Tapita SEO Optimizer
desc: Shopify SEO app combining site audits with LLMs.txt for AI search engines, bulk and AI-written metadata, image alt text and compression, JSON-LD schema, broken-link auto-redirects and one-click speed fixes.

name: Tapstitch
desc: Fashion-first print-on-demand for brand-builders: premium heavyweight blanks (streetwear tees, oversized hoodies), bigger print areas and made-to-order apparel with no inventory. Integrates with Shopify.

name: Tax1099
desc: Per-form e-filing of 1099s, W-2s and related forms, cheaper per form at high volume, with a subscription for frequent filers. TIN matching, W-9 requests, state filing and corrections can each carry their own charge, so tally the add-ons.

name: TaxCycle
desc: Professional tax preparation and CRA e-filing for Canadian accountants and bookkeepers, sold per module and per user, with bundles for the full suite. Canada-only, and not a consumer filing app.

name: Team Pulse
desc: Projects, tasks, chat, files and a light CRM pipeline in one tool. The listed rates assume annual billing.
Advertising optimisation for Amazon and Walmart sellers, with inventory and catalogue signals.
name: Teikametrics
Tellent
desc: Modular people-management platform: applicant tracking (Recruitee), core HR and performance management with AI automation, for hiring and managing teams.

name: Tenable
desc: Exposure and vulnerability management (makers of Nessus): scan, prioritize and remediate security weaknesses across IT, cloud and OT, for security teams of any size.
Pre-employment skills testing: assessment library, custom questions and candidate scoring.
name: TestGorilla
TextExpander
desc: Text-expansion tool: you type a short abbreviation and it expands into a stored snippet system-wide on macOS and Windows and in Chrome, with fill-in fields, nested snippets, date maths and scripting. The real product is the team layer: a shared snippet library with permissions, sign-up by email domain, auto-subscribe for new hires, usage statistics and SSO, aimed at support, clinical-admin, recruiting and sales teams that need everyone sending the same approved wording. The vendor self-attests SOC 2/SOC 3 and HIPAA compliance with a BAA available, which is the clearest argument for paying rather than using a free expander.
Business SMS for support and sales teams: shared inboxes, automations and compliance tooling.
name: Textline
TheTop
desc: An enterprise layer in front of your AI providers: it attributes spend by department, reuses repeated work, routes each task to a cheaper model and applies policy before execution.

name: Thordata
desc: Proxy infrastructure and scraping stack: residential, mobile, ISP and datacenter proxies plus SERP/web-scraper APIs, priced per GB, IP or 1K requests.
Platform for small service businesses that combines CRM, scheduling, invoicing, reviews and marketing.
name: Thryv
TicketTailor
desc: Low-fee event ticketing and box-office software: sell tickets online, manage check-in and keep more of your revenue without per-ticket booking fees.

name: Tidio
desc: Live chat, ticketing and the Lyro AI agent in one platform: AI answers routine questions from your own data, hands the rest to the team with context, and Flows chase leads proactively. Lyro also plugs into Zendesk, Intercom, Salesforce and 20+ platforms without migration, but only on Premium.

name: TiXel
desc: Shopify app for Meta and TikTok pixels, with unlimited pixels, product-level scoping and server-side Events API tracking on one flat plan.

name: TnC
desc: Shopify app that puts a mandatory “I agree to the terms” checkbox on the cart and on the Buy It Now, PayPal and Apple Pay express buttons, logs the consent timestamp against the order, and can show it only for chosen products or countries for GDPR and age gates.

name: Todoist
desc: Task manager for individuals and small teams: quick capture, due dates and projects across devices. A to-do app, not a project suite with timelines or dependencies.

name: Toggl
desc: Time tracking and capacity planning for freelancers, consultants and agencies, with budgets, rates and profitability per project. Relaunched from Toggl Track to Toggl in 2026.

name: Top Echelon
desc: Recruiting software for agencies and staffing firms: TE Recruit is an ATS and CRM with resume parsing, pipeline management, hotlists and job-board integrations, while TE Network is a split-placement network for sharing roles and candidates with other recruiting firms.

name: Tradify
desc: Specialized job management software for trade businesses. Handle quoting, scheduling, and invoicing from the field.

name: Trainerize
desc: Personal training and fitness-coaching platform. Deliver workout and nutrition plans, message clients and take payments from one branded app, so trainers can coach more clients online.

name: Trainual
desc: Documents SOPs and runs new-hire onboarding, with AI that drafts and updates training docs from your own account context.

name: Tresorit
desc: End-to-end encrypted cloud storage and secure file sharing. Protect sensitive business documents with zero-knowledge security and granular access controls.

name: Turbotic
desc: Enterprise automation orchestration. Manage all of your RPA, AI and scripts from a single control tower.

name: Typewise
desc: AI agents for customer service that resolve requests end to end and take action in the systems you already run - CRM, ERP, billing, commerce - configured in plain language.

name: UENI
desc: A done-for-you small-business website, built for you rather than a builder you have to learn: a one-time build fee plus a monthly plan that includes domain, email and a launch call. DIY editing is limited and the seven-day promise often slips.

name: UltaHost
desc: Budget-friendly web hosting across shared, VPS, WordPress and dedicated plans, with NVMe SSD storage, free SSL and migration, DDoS protection and 24/7 multilingual support, from 30+ global data centers.

name: Unbounce
desc: Landing page builder for paid campaigns, with A/B testing and Smart Traffic routing each visitor to the best-converting variant.

name: Uniqode
desc: Dynamic QR codes and digital business cards with real-time scan analytics, to connect offline touchpoints to measurable results and capture leads.

name: UniTel Voice
desc: Virtual business phone system for small teams. Get a toll-free or local number with auto-attendant, call routing and a mobile app, with no hardware.

name: Unleashed Software
desc: Inventory and MRP software for manufacturers and wholesalers: real-time stock across warehouses, purchasing, sales orders and batch or serial tracking. The entry price covers 3 users and 100 sales orders a month; past that the bill stacks up.

name: Upsell.com
desc: Shopify upsell app, formerly ReConvert: AI-driven cart, checkout and post-purchase upsell and cross-sell funnels, frequently-bought-together and product page recommendations, A/B testing and analytics with segmentation.

name: UpsellPlus
desc: Upsells, cross-sells and free gifts across Shopify product pages, cart, checkout, post-purchase, customer accounts and POS, with AI recommendations and A/B testing in 23 storefront languages.

name: UptimeRobot
desc: Uptime monitoring with a generous free tier: website, port, keyword and API checks down to 60-second intervals, status pages, integrations and mobile apps.

name: VEA
desc: AI built for entrepreneurs, not enterprises: VEA learns your business like a great employee would, finds the constraint keeping you stuck and helps you solve it, then finds the next one.

name: Velora
desc: Operations platform for nonprofits: Keela (donor CRM), Aplos (fund accounting) and Raisely (online fundraising) as one connected suite, with donor management, campaigns and finances built for charities instead of adapted from business software.

name: Vida AI
desc: Deploy autonomous frontline voice agents. Let AI answer calls, book appointments, and handle FAQs 24/7 without sounding robotic.

name: VideoScribe
desc: Whiteboard and hand-drawn animation software for explainer and training videos: build scenes from a large image library, add text, music and voiceover, with AI tools for scripts, images and voiceovers; priced per licence by downloads and video length.

name: VidPal
desc: Autonomous content engine for faceless and topic-based channels: it discovers trending stories in your niche, auto-generates short-form videos and carousels with AI voiceovers, and auto-publishes them across Instagram, TikTok, YouTube and more.

name: Vista Social
desc: Unified social media management and publishing. Schedule posts, manage conversations, and track analytics across all your brand accounts.

name: Volza
desc: Export-import trade intelligence: search customs-level shipment records to find verified buyers and suppliers. Downloads run on a published credit allowance, from 360,000 full-shipment credits a year.

name: Voye
desc: Pooled eSIM data for travelling teams, billed on actual usage rather than prepaid bundles, with per-user spend controls. Coverage and speed vary by country and carrier partner, so pilot your heaviest routes first; the vendor's roaming-savings figures stay claims until your invoice confirms them.

name: VWO
desc: A/B testing and conversion optimization platform. Run experiments, heatmaps and personalization to lift conversions without developers.

name: Warmup Inbox
desc: Standalone email warm-up service with automated inbox warming, deliverability monitoring and integrations for Google, Outlook, Zoho and SendGrid.

name: Wati
desc: WhatsApp Business API platform for sales and support: shared team inbox, bulk broadcasts and no-code chatbots, plus Astra, its AI agent builder for agents that actually resolve conversations (orders, refunds, bookings, lead qualification) across WhatsApp, web and voice. Its omnichannel inbox now also carries TikTok DMs natively (all plans, no extra cost) alongside Instagram and RCS, with ad-to-chat context that shows exactly which TikTok ad triggered a conversation. It now ships its own MCP server as well: connect Claude or ChatGPT once and manage contacts, send WhatsApp campaigns, read past chats and build agents in plain language, while sends still run on your own approved templates and the full history stays in the Wati dashboard. Wati's own page puts the cost like this: free for current paid Astra customers with no usage cap during launch, and full MCP access on every Astra plan for new customers (checked 4 Aug 2026).

name: Way
desc: Shopify store locator on Google Maps with no API key needed, priced by location count rather than by feature: the paid tiers add locations and nothing else, and it also works with Apple Maps and Mapbox.

name: Weave
desc: Phone, texting, payments and reviews unified for the front desk, tuned to dental, optometry and small healthcare practices. Get the all-in number in writing.

name: WebCatalog
desc: Turn web apps into tidy desktop apps and manage multiple accounts side by side. Less tab chaos, more focus, with your whole stack organized in one place.
Visual website builder that writes production code: design, CMS, hosting and ecommerce in one place.
name: Webflow
WebinarGeek
desc: European live and automated webinar platform with viewer-tier pricing, engagement tools, CRM integrations and GDPR-friendly hosting. The vendor states you can now generate a full webinar (including polls, quizzes and a registration page) from a plain-text description, with UTM tracking and post-webinar redirects on the registration page (vendor mail, August 2026).

name: Wegic
desc: AI website builder that generates and hosts sites from a conversation, credit-based, with custom domains and code export on higher tiers. Wegic's own help center documents images only by upload or external URL; the built-in image generation the vendor promotes, including a product-photo-to-product-page pass, is not in that documentation, and our visitor-mode test on 5 November 2026 did not cover it. A one-click optimize pass audits a published site for SEO and site-health problems and applies the fixes itself. It was vendor-announced in July 2026, and we have not tested it.

name: WhatConverts
desc: Lead tracking and marketing attribution. Capture calls, forms and chats and tie every lead back to the campaign that drove it, for clear ROI.

name: Wholesale Gorilla
desc: B2B wholesale inside an ordinary Shopify store: custom prices per customer group, a signup and approval flow, net payment terms, wholesale-only shipping rules and a quick-order form, so trade buyers order from the same storefront as retail customers. Nothing is metered: the three tiers gate features, not volume. Read on the App Store and the vendor's own comparison chart on 8 September 2026.

name: Wing Assistant
desc: Managed virtual assistants for founders and teams: delegate admin, inbox, scheduling and repetitive tasks to a dedicated, trained assistant.
Video hosting built for marketing, with player customisation, viewer analytics and lead capture.
name: Wistia
Wiz Checkout Upsell
desc: Shopify checkout and post-purchase app from Skai Lama: upsells, volume discounts, subscription upgrades and free gifts, plus checkout banners, trust badges, input fields and gift messages, with thank-you and order status page offers behind them.

name: Woodpecker
desc: Cold email and LinkedIn outreach platform priced by contacted prospects, with unlimited team seats and email accounts, built-in warm-ups, deliverability tooling and a lead finder.

name: World Businesses for Sale
desc: International marketplace for buying and selling established businesses (restaurants, shops, services and manufacturers), free for buyers, with broker plans (listing fee plus 1-3% commission) or no-commission pay-as-you-go listings, and 24/7 guidance for sellers.

name: WP Rocket
desc: WordPress caching and performance plugin: page cache, lazy loading, file optimisation and CDN integration from one settings screen. Stop paying and you keep your settings but lose updates and support.

name: Wrike
desc: Work management for mid-to-large teams running cross-functional projects: reporting, workflows, approvals and resource management.
Cloud accounting for small business: bank reconciliation, invoicing, bills and reporting.
name: Xero
Your Company Formations
desc: Online UK company formation agent: forms limited companies, LLPs, PLCs and other company types, with optional London registered office and service addresses, mail forwarding, VAT registration and annual filing services, for UK and overseas founders.

name: Zedonk
desc: Fashion-industry ERP for small and mid-size brands: modular sales, production, inventory and wholesale management with a B2B digital showroom, priced per module on annual billing.

name: Zeffy
desc: Fundraising, ticketing and donation payments for nonprofits with no platform, transaction or card-processing fees. The model is an optional tip prompt shown to your donors at checkout, which they can set to zero. Weigh that against the percentage paid platforms take from every donation.

name: ZenBusiness
desc: US business-formation service covering LLC, S corp and C corp filings with no service fee beyond the state's own. The money is in the recurring stack around it: registered agent, compliance service, operating agreement and EIN, each priced individually rather than bundled into tiers.
Customer service suite: ticketing, messaging, voice, help centre and AI agents.
name: Zendesk
Zendrop
desc: AI dropshipping and print-on-demand for Shopify: browse 1M+ products from US and global suppliers, link them to your store and let fulfilment and tracking run automatically, with custom branding, POD and 3PL as you scale.

name: ZenZap
desc: Secure work chat for teams: organized channels, built-in tasks and workflows, AI agents and admin controls, as easy to use as texting.

name: ZoomInfo
desc: Enterprise B2B sales intelligence and contact database. Find verified company and contact data, buying signals and org charts to fuel outbound at scale.

name: SEOKart
desc: Shopify and BigCommerce SEO app with one-click AI optimisation: bulk meta tags, image alt text and file names, URL edits, JSON-LD schema and rich snippets, 404 fixing and 301 redirects, image compression for page speed, and a built-in keyword rank tracker with a Cruise Control auto-SEO mode.

name: Super
desc: Shopify gift app that adds paid or free gift wrap, gift boxes, greeting cards, a gift message and a price-hiding gift receipt to the product page, cart or Plus checkout, and tags those orders automatically for fulfilment.

name: Trackr
desc: Shopify order-tracking app that replaces carrier links with one branded tracking page: estimated delivery dates, email, WhatsApp and US SMS updates, Apple and Google Wallet tracking, 2,100-plus carriers, shipping analytics and product recommendations on the tracking page.

name: Nexis CRO
desc: Shopify app that runs a 34-check SEO and AEO audit across products, collections, pages and policies, rewrites the gaps with AI, deploys JSON-LD schema and an llms.txt file, and tracks whether ChatGPT, Gemini and Perplexity cite your store.

name: Dynasort
desc: Shopify app that re-sorts collections, variant lists, search results and upsell blocks automatically, using recipes built from 60+ signals such as sales, margin, inventory and reviews.

name: Signitic
desc: Email signature management for Google Workspace and Microsoft 365: central templates, per-entity branding, and clickable banner campaigns with click statistics. ISO 27001 certified and hosted in Europe.

name: Kumo
desc: Shopify wholesale app from Cloudlift GmbH: unlimited custom pricing rules that apply automatically to named customer groups, CSV import and export of price lists, B2B registration forms with an approval workflow, and prices that update in the theme without code edits. Built for Shopify, launched November 2024.

name: MX AI
desc: Shopify app that plays a track of your choice in the background of a storefront, with control over the player's colour, size, position, volume, loop and autoplay, and sources ranging from an uploaded MP3 to Spotify, SoundCloud, Apple Music and YouTube formats. Built for Shopify, live since January 2020.

name: Helm
desc: Shopify business-intelligence app (sold on the vendor's own site under the GrowGiant brand, by PactAI, LLC of Texas) that reads Shopify, QuickBooks Online, Meta Ads, Google Ads and GA4 together and flags what is costing money: discount and pricing drift, unexplained cost movements, inventory risk, ad performance deteriorating beyond normal variation, and sales anomalies against day, week, month and last year. Adds a drag-and-drop KPI dashboard, scenario modelling and a recurring management review. Integrations are read-only; the listing requests view permissions only. Launched 7 September 2026, still no reviews as of 16 Sep 2026.

name: PhotoGenerator
desc: AI image and video generator that puts a dozen third-party models behind one credit balance and one workspace: Nano Banana (three variants) and GPT Image 2 for stills, Seedance, Kling, Veo 3 and Wan 2.5 for video, plus face swap, background removal, upscaling, style transfer, lip-sync, motion sync, character creation and voice tools. A prompt gallery carries thousands of community prompts with the image each produced, reusable as prompt or reference.

name: Skip To Checkout
desc: Free Shopify app from Effective Apps that puts a sticky add-to-cart bar on product pages and can send the shopper straight to checkout, skipping the cart. It also hides PayPal, Apple Pay or the add-to-cart and buy-now buttons when you want a single path to payment. Free is the only plan and there is no usage meter. Built for Shopify, on the App Store since November 2019.

name: Social Bar
desc: Shopify app from Effective Apps that adds a bar of social media icons and share buttons to storefront pages, covering more than 80 platforms, with a per-platform Follow Us bar, shape and colour options, an animation, a one-click hide for shoppers and a click counter. Built for Shopify, on the App Store since April 2020.

name: TestDriver.ai
desc: AI QA engineer that lives in GitHub: mention @testdriverai in a pull request or issue and it starts a real desktop sandbox, runs your application, writes and runs an end-to-end UI test, posts a recording, and commits the test file to your repository, then reruns it on every pull request that touches the same ground. Tests are written against behaviour rather than selectors (find “signup button”, assert “dashboard is visible”). Covers web apps, Chrome and VSCode extensions, Windows desktop and Linux; Mac, iOS and Android are Enterprise-only and marked coming soon. By Haxor Inc.

name: Influencer Hero
desc: Influencer marketing platform combining AI creator discovery, automated outreach, an influencer CRM, UGC tracking and affiliate management on one record per creator, with 45-plus native integrations and payouts run through bank debit at 0.1-0.4% rather than 2-3% card fees. Every plan carries the full toolset; the ladder is gated on quota and seats. A reach-out is counted once when a new influencer is first contacted, and all later messaging with that creator is unlimited. Three-month minimum on every plan and no free trial.

name: Niural AI
desc: Payroll, benefits, HR, PEO and global hiring from one vendor, and (rare in this category) every product carries a published price. Every tier is demo-led with no self-serve sign-up, and the pricing page asks your headcount band before it shows a ladder.

name: Poptin
desc: Popups, forms and coupons with a drag-and-drop editor, exit-intent and cart triggers, A/B testing, 70-plus native integrations and an email-marketing side with campaigns, automations and segments. Metered on unique monthly visitors, counted once per browser per 30 days. Sold two ways: a popup-only product priced by visitors, or Emails & Poptins priced by the size of your email list.

name: rePete
desc: Shopify app by Bold that predicts when each customer is due to reorder and nudges them at that moment by email, SMS, WhatsApp or on-site, with a one-click Smart Cart and tiered loyalty discounts instead of a subscription. Priced purely on results: free to install, then 3% of reorders completed within 24 hours of a nudge, 1% within seven days, and 5% on anything added beyond the reorder product, with no SMS, email, per-contact, push or app fees and no minimum. There is no ceiling and no volume discount either, so the bill scales with the result indefinitely. Launched 4 July 2025, with nine reviews.

name: Selleasy
desc: Shopify upsell and cross-sell app (by Logbase): bundles and product add-ons on the product page, add-on pop-ups and response-based funnels on the cart, one-click post-purchase offers and thank-you page add-ons. Flat plans with no order limit and no share of upsell revenue, including a free plan with up to five campaigns.

name: Warn
desc: Shopify app from Effective Apps that adds customizable warnings (Prop 65 labels, shipping-delay alerts, age-verification and withdrawal disclaimers) to product, cart and checkout pages, as text or pop-ups, targeted globally or by product, collection, country or US state. On the App Store since December 2019.

name: Gushwork
desc: AI marketing agents for small and mid-sized businesses, sold as one done-for-you system rather than a seat: it publishes pages built for AI search and Google, keeps a brand-memory source of truth, tracks every visitor, filters spam out of the leads dashboard and runs paid campaigns alongside.

name: Loyalino
desc: Shopify loyalty app from OkayScale: points on orders and actions, VIP tiers by points or spend, referrals with dual-sided rewards, shown in a floating widget, the cart, product pages, customer accounts, a standalone storefront page and Shopify POS. Runs in the EU, ships in eight languages. Launched June 2026, no reviews yet.

name: LumenCart
desc: Shopify app from Fleeta that turns the product photos you already have into AI studio and lifestyle images, one at a time or in bulk, and publishes them to the product in one click. The per-credit rate stops improving at Pro. Launched August 2026, no reviews yet.

name: VyReel
desc: Shopify app that turns Instagram and TikTok reels or your own UGC into shoppable carousels, stories, grids and a watch-and-buy viewer, with AI product tagging on every plan.

name: Bot It AI
desc: Shopify app that audits every product for the data AI shopping agents rank on (categories, attributes, barcodes, alt text, variants, policies), maintains llms.txt and agents.md, and on Pro writes the missing fields with one-click revert and tracks placement in AI shopping results. Launched May 2026, no reviews yet.

name: DocSend
desc: Dropbox's secure document sharing and data room tool: send a deck or a data room as a tracked link, see page-by-page who read what, and gate access with email authentication, NDAs and watermarks.

name: Timesact Preorder
desc: Shopify pre-orders, deposits and split payments, back-in-stock and coming-soon sign-ups.

name: SoftSync
desc: Flexible B2B CRM for small sales teams: records and custom objects, table, pipeline and calendar views, email sync and campaigns, meeting notes and summaries, Autopilot follow-up workflows, and API and MCP access so Claude, ChatGPT or Gemini can work with the CRM directly.

name: Rapid Search
desc: Shopify app that replaces the search icon with an always-visible AI search bar (typo tolerance, synonyms, instant results, SKU search) and adds product and collection filters on tags and metafields, hand-set pins and boosts, and search analytics.

name: Lovable
desc: AI app builder that turns a written description into a web app with a database and hosting, published to a lovable.app address in one click. Billing is in credits whose cost per message depends on the work, and a published app's backend runs on a separate monthly Cloud allowance.

name: Track123
desc: Shopify order-tracking app: a branded tracking page and order lookup on your own store, synced from 1,500+ carriers, with Shopify shipping emails pointed at that page, a dropshipping mode that hides origin details, and PayPal and Stripe tracking sync. Priced on synced orders a month, with a free tier; estimated delivery dates and branding removal sit on the higher Advanced plan.

name: Pickeasy
desc: Shopify local pickup and delivery scheduler (by Logbase): customers pick a date and time slot, with cut-off and preparation times, blackout dates, per-slot order limits and zip-code checks, across one to twenty locations. Tiers are gated on locations and rate rules, and the app's own delivery rates need Shopify's carrier-calculated shipping.

name: FBtrack
desc: Shopify app that installs several Meta, TikTok, Snapchat and Pinterest pixels at once, with Conversions API and server-side event tracking for each; plans differ only in how many pixels are active.

name: Essential Countdown Timer Bar
desc: Shopify countdown timer app for announcement bars, product pages, landing pages, carts and emails, with dated, recurring and evergreen timers, geo-targeting and a free plan; priced on how many times the timers load each month.

name: GCheck
desc: US employment background screening sold per check: criminal, identity, sanctions and driving records, verifications, drug testing and I-9/E-Verify, with FCRA workflows and ATS and HRIS integrations for hiring teams.

name: Essential Announcement Bar
desc: Shopify announcement bar app for static, rotating and scrolling top, bottom and cart-page bars with links, icons, scheduling, geo-targeting and translations; priced on how many times the bars load each month.

name: Essential Free Shipping Bar
desc: Shopify free-shipping progress bar for the top bar, product pages and cart, with cart goals, upsell products, geo-targeting and product exclusions; the free-shipping rate itself is set in Shopify.

name: Mera Work
desc: Employee monitoring and time tracking for remote, hybrid and office teams: automatic timesheets, attendance and shifts, app and website usage, screenshots and live screen view, all in one per-user plan.

name: Koala Bundles
desc: Shopify app (by ProfitKoala) for quantity breaks, multi-product bundles, cart volume discounts, BOGO offers and one-click post-purchase upsells, with an announcement bar and countdown timer; every plan has the same features and is metered on the bundle revenue the offers bring in.

name: Essential Trust Badges
desc: Shopify app (by Essential Apps) that adds payment icons, feature icons, guarantee badges and promo banners to product pages, the cart or any theme position, with your own icons, country targeting and translations; plans are metered on widget views.

name: SalesTarget.ai
desc: B2B outbound platform combining a lead database of 840M+ professional profiles with credit-based enrichment, cold email with no stated cap on connected inboxes (warmup covers 5 on the entry plan), LinkedIn automation, and a built-in CRM and dialer. Sold as separate modules or one bundle per team.

name: StoreLock
desc: Shopify app (by Williams Web Services) that finds cloned storefronts, lookalike domains and stolen product photos, packages the evidence and sends DMCA and abuse reports from the app, with on-site copy protection and country blocking.

name: Jane
desc: Practice management for allied health clinics such as physiotherapy, chiropractic, massage and counselling: online booking through a branded site, charting templates, intake forms, 1:1 and group telehealth, reminders, invoicing and integrated payments, with an AI scribe and insurance billing as add-ons.

name: Brandye
desc: Shopify app that adds an AI product-finder quiz, AI-generated questions and answers on product pages and an AI shopping assistant trained on your catalogue, with email capture and sync to Klaviyo and other marketing tools.

name: Seele
desc: AI game-studio agent that turns a text prompt, image or drawing into a playable 2D or 3D game in the browser, with Three.js, Unity and Unreal targets and generated 3D assets, images, video and audio, billed in Koin credits.

name: Essential Upsell & Cross Sell
desc: Shopify upsell and cross-sell app with frequently-bought-together blocks, product-page and cart-drawer offers, one-click post-purchase upsells, bundles, add-ons and automatic discounts, with plans tiered by the extra revenue the app attributes to its offers.

name: Koala Gifts
desc: Shopify app by ProfitKoala for free gifts with purchase, BOGO and buy-X-get-Y offers, gift pickers, product add-ons and add-to-cart upsell pop-ups, with plans set by the store's Shopify plan rather than by orders or revenue.

name: Create
desc: UK-based hosted website builder with templates, a blog, custom forms and an online shop with card and pay-later payments, marketplace shopping feeds and Royal Mail shipping, plus a dedicated account manager on every package.

name: DigitalOcean
desc: Developer cloud for running apps, APIs and databases: virtual servers (Droplets), a managed app platform, managed databases, Kubernetes, object storage and on-demand GPUs, billed per second.

name: Harbor Compliance
desc: US business compliance service and software: registered agent addresses in every state, LLC formation and incorporation, annual report filing, foreign qualification, licensing and an Entity Manager that tracks each entity's status and deadlines, for companies registered in several states and the firms that manage them.

name: Essent Preorder Back in Stock
desc: Shopify pre-order and back-in-stock app: presale and made-to-order campaigns with deposits and split payments, a Notify me waitlist with automatic restock emails, mixed-cart rules and market targeting, with plans tiered by monthly pre-orders and notifications.

name: Krystal
desc: UK web hosting company, a certified B Corp running on renewable energy, selling cPanel shared, business and reseller hosting, managed WordPress, configurable VPS and public cloud, with UK-based support by ticket, live chat and phone.

name: Bold Subscriptions
desc: Shopify subscription app by Bold: subscribe-and-save, replenishment, prepaid and subscription-box offers with a customer portal, dunning for failed payments, cancellation flows, upsells and free migration from other subscription apps.

name: Bold Memberships
desc: Shopify membership and loyalty app by Bold: free and paid tiers, store credit, loyalty points, member pricing and free shipping, gated products and checkout, Shopify POS sign-ups and Apple and Google Wallet cards.

name: Bold Upsell
desc: Shopify upsell app by Bold: AI-picked and manual upsells, cross-sells, order bumps, free gifts and subscription offers on product pages, cart and drawer and after purchase, with checkout offers for Shopify Plus stores and an AOV dashboard.

name: Bold Custom Pricing
desc: Shopify wholesale and B2B pricing app by Bold: separate prices for tagged customer groups, VIP and member tiers, quantity breaks and tiered pricing on one storefront, without Shopify Plus.

name: Database Mart
desc: US hosting company running its own servers in Dallas: Linux and Windows VPS, dedicated servers and NVIDIA GPU servers from entry cards to A100 and H100, with root access, a 24-hour trial on request and round-the-clock human support.

name: bOnline
desc: UK business phone provider for small businesses: a VoIP number on your mobile app or desk phone, unlimited UK calling, call recording, call queues and IVR, and AI transcription and call summaries on its top plan.

name: Zoviz
desc: AI logo maker and brand platform: design a logo and brand kit for free, then download it with a subscription that adds 5,000+ on-brand templates, AI marketing content, link-in-bio pages, digital business cards and a website builder.

name: Positive User
desc: Marketing automation platform from the French Positive group, formerly User.com: email, SMS and WhatsApp campaigns, real-time visitor tracking, website personalisation and workflows, hosted in Europe.

name: UserTrail
desc: Website behaviour analytics: heatmaps, session replays, funnels, form analytics, journeys and on-site surveys from one tracking script, with a free plan to start.

name: AccuWeb Hosting
desc: Hosting provider for Linux and Windows VPS, Forex VPS, one-click application servers and dedicated servers in more than 20 locations, with 24/7 support.

name: Zenind
desc: Online US company formation for LLCs and corporations, with registered agent, EIN and BOI report preparation, compliance reminders and a company dashboard, aimed at founders inside and outside the US.

name: NameRobot
desc: Naming tools for companies and products: a toolbox of 100+ name generators, an AI naming assistant, and paid NameScore reports that check availability, trademarks and the sound of a name.

name: Vendoo
desc: Crosslisting app for online resellers: list an item once to eBay, Poshmark, Mercari, Depop, Etsy and more, with sale detection that delists sold items everywhere, inventory and profit tracking.

name: Weblium
desc: Template-based website builder for small businesses, with an AI assistant, lead capture forms and integrations, and an online store, blog and multilingual pages on the Business plan.

name: 24-7PressRelease
desc: Press release distribution service running since 2004, paid per release, from a post on its own news site up to national wire distribution through PR Newswire.

name: Contabo
desc: Unmanaged cloud VPS and virtual dedicated servers with a lot of RAM and CPU per plan, unlimited traffic under fair use, and data centres in Europe, the US, Asia and Australia.

name: NordPass
desc: Password manager from the makers of NordVPN for individuals, families and companies: password sharing, breach monitoring, MFA and SSO, with admin controls on the business plans.

name: CO2 Impact
desc: UK carbon reporting software for small and mid-sized businesses: emissions from bills and uploads across Scope 1, 2 and 3, a carbon reduction plan, SECR reports and optional automated meter data.

name: Omneky
desc: AI ad platform that generates image and video ads, including avatar and clone videos, launches them to Meta, Google, TikTok and other channels, and reports performance per creative.

name: Wondershare PDFelement
desc: Desktop PDF editor for Windows and Mac with OCR, forms, conversion, redaction and an AI assistant, sold as a yearly, two-year or one-time licence.

name: iubenda
desc: Compliance platform for websites and apps: cookie consent banner with consent log, generated privacy, cookie and terms documents, and Google Consent Mode, priced per site by pageviews.

name: Brizy
desc: Drag-and-drop website builder with an AI builder, hosted on Brizy Cloud or as a WordPress plugin, with multi-site agency plans and a white-label version for resellers.

name: Optery
desc: Personal data removal service that scans people-search sites and data brokers for your name and address and files opt-out requests, from a free self-service report to managed removals with a human agent.

name: Lusha
desc: B2B contact and company database with a Chrome extension for LinkedIn and websites: verified emails and direct dials, CRM enrichment, buying-intent signals and an API, paid in credits.

name: Help Scout
desc: Email-first shared inbox for support teams with live chat, social messaging, a knowledge base, workflows and an AI assistant that answers customer questions.

name: LifterLMS
desc: WordPress plugin for building and selling online courses and memberships, with a free open-source core and paid add-ons for payments, email marketing, quizzes and groups.

name: Samsara
desc: Fleet operations platform: AI dash cams, GPS telematics, ELD compliance and trailer and equipment tracking, sold as separate packages to fleets.

name: Upsell & Cross Sell - AW
desc: Shopify upsell and cross-sell app by Aheadworks: hand-picked or automatic related-product recommendations, frequently-bought-together bundles and one-click add-ons on product pages, cart, checkout, thank-you and post-purchase pages, priced by recommendation clicks.

name: Vify Order Printer
desc: Shopify invoice and order printer app: customisable PDF invoices, packing slips, refunds, quotes and B2B invoices with VAT numbers, in several languages and currencies, with bulk printing and automatic invoice emails.

name: Shopmonkey
desc: Shop management software for auto repair shops: estimates and invoices, digital vehicle inspections, customer texting, parts lookup and ordering, inventory, labor guides and integrated payments.

name: Pagecloud
desc: AI website builder for small businesses: describe your business and Pagecloud AI builds the site, which you edit by chat or on the page, with inquiry forms, privacy-first analytics, SEO settings and hosting included.

name: Vanity Number
desc: Marketplace for memorable North American local and toll-free phone numbers, sold as a one-time purchase and ported to the carrier or VoIP service you already use.

name: WPLP
desc: WordPress compliance platform from the makers of WP Legal Pages: free plugins for a cookie consent banner with script blocking and Google Consent Mode v2 and for generated legal pages, plus a paid dashboard priced by number of sites with TCF and geo-targeting.

name: HostPapa
desc: Small-business web host with cPanel shared and WordPress hosting, VPS and dedicated servers, domains, business email and a website builder, with free migration, 24/7 phone, chat and email support and published renewal prices.

name: Pixlr
desc: Browser, desktop and mobile photo editor with AI image, video and voice generation; a free version with ads and paid plans that add ad-free editing, AI credits and a template library.

name: PostOnce
desc: Social media scheduler that publishes one post to Instagram, TikTok, YouTube, Facebook, LinkedIn, Pinterest, X and Bluesky, with a queue, calendar, recurring posts and clear failure and reconnect warnings; flat plans without per-channel fees.

name: Sender
desc: Email and SMS marketing platform for small businesses and shops: newsletters, automation, landing pages, signup forms and popups and transactional email, with a generous free plan and paid tiers priced by list size.

name: xTiles
desc: Visual workspace that combines notes, projects, tasks and a daily planner with templates and an AI assistant, and connects ChatGPT and Claude to your projects through MCP; a free plan and per-user paid plans.

name: CiteRoute
desc: Generative engine optimisation tool that scores how ready a site is to be cited by AI answer engines, generates agent.json and llms.txt files, and logs AI crawler visits on verified sites; free plan plus paid tracking plans.

name: DigiParser
desc: Document extraction for manufacturers that turns customer purchase orders and supplier invoices into structured fields and line items, with review before export, email-inbox processing, an API and integrations; priced by pages per month.

name: Chatwith
desc: No-code AI agent builder that trains a support chatbot on your website, docs, files and connected apps, answers customers on your site, WhatsApp, Instagram, Messenger, Slack or Telegram, collects leads and escalates to a person; priced by message credits.

name: PulseMonitor
desc: Uptime monitoring for developers and small teams: HTTP, API, port, keyword and SSL checks with incident history, plus a built-in SEO site audit; free plan with 50 monitors and a paid plan for 1-minute checks, webhooks, status pages and heartbeats.

name: FeedbackGate
desc: Review-request software that sends automated email and SMS asks, routes ratings and alerts on negative feedback; plans by contacts and message volume, with white-label for agencies.

name: Content Raptor
desc: SEO content tool that ranks your pages by traffic potential from Google Search Console data, suggests missing keywords and entities with an AI rewriter, and measures changes with A/B tests and daily rank tracking; priced per site.

name: Deftform
desc: Hosted form builder from Germany with unlimited responses and team members, conditional logic, file uploads, Stripe payments, webhooks and an API; priced per form, monthly or as a one-time lifetime licence.

name: WhisperTranscribe
desc: AI transcription and translation for podcasts, videos and interviews with speaker detection, content generation and many export formats, plus a bot-free meeting assistant; plans by minutes a month with unlimited users.

name: SurFox AI
desc: AI agent that texts, qualifies and books leads over SMS, website chat and inbound voice calls, then hands the ready ones to your team; aimed at staffing, real estate and home-services firms in the US.

name: Inbox Zero
